originStory.title: Why I Built This
originStory.subtitle: From drowning to systems that actually work
originStory.story: I didn't create the Knowledge Worker Kit because I'm naturally organized. I created it because I know what it's like to feel disorganized and overwhelmed. As a shy, introverted teenager, I found refuge in writing, building websites, learning IT and organizing information. Decades later, I was constantly struggling. A failed startup cost me 200k euros. Burnout from trying to do everything through sheer willpower. The transition from introverted engineer to leader was painful. Losing loved ones and questioning what really matters. These experiences forced me to build systems that actually work and protect my physical and mental health. Practical systems I use every day. Today, I'm almost always calm, despite a demanding life. I have 3 kids, work part-time as an employee, run a company on the side, build products, manage communities, write articles, newsletters, publish videos and courses, ... And I still feel ZEN.. The Knowledge Worker Kit is everything I wish I knew and had when I started.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized you need clarity on what matters before any system can work
